tests.title: Admin exports OKR custom fields to CSV with expected columns
tests.customer_impact: Admins cannot bulk-export field data; migration and audits are blocked.
tests.test_data_prerequisites: Staging tenant with at least two OKR custom fields and sample OKR records.
tests.preconditions: User has OKR admin role; feature flag for CSV export enabled on staging.

steps.step: Open **Settings → OKR → Custom fields** and choose **Export CSV**.
steps.expected_result: Export dialog or action starts; no permission error.

steps.step: Download the generated file and open it in a spreadsheet tool.
steps.expected_result: CSV contains header row with field name, type, and applicable goal type columns per AC-01.

tests.title: Export is denied for user without OKR admin permission
tests.customer_impact: Unauthorized users could exfiltrate configuration data if permission checks fail.
tests.deferrable_rationale: Covered indirectly by broader RBAC suite when time-boxed.
tests.test_data_prerequisites: Standard user account on staging; export UI reachable but action must be blocked.
tests.preconditions: Logged in as standard user without custom-field admin rights.

steps.step: Navigate to the same export entry point as TC-001.
steps.expected_result: Export control is hidden or disabled, or action returns a clear permission error.
